name: Night Watch
text: Whenever a rival takes the Goes Last token, +1 follower per minion on it.

name: Second-Story Men
text: Round End: before contests are scored, steal 2 resources from one rival.

name: Hawkers
text: On Use, once per round: choose a shop member. Starting on your left, each rival may recruit it, paying its cost plus 2 to you. If none does, you recruit it for free.

name: Sore Losers
text: Round End: if you win no contest, steal 3 followers from the rival who wins the most.
